_meta.purpose: Per-SKU DTC product cost (COGS) + full retail price. Consumed by Module A (attribution & unit-economics) to compute contribution margin per order.
_meta.cost_source: gebeauty/boxes/'Estudo estoque 2026 apresentacao (1).xlsx' -> Planilha1 'Preco minimo' (B2B break-even). That study added +R$2,00/unit of B2B/wholesale handling ('Considerei R$ 2,00'). For DTC we STRIP that R$2 (B2B-specific) and instead charge DTC fulfillment as 3% of revenue in params.json (Lucas, 2026-07-21). So unit_cost_brl below = study value MINUS 2.00 = true DTC product cost (formula + packaging).
_meta.retail_source: Shopify list price (productType=product), full-size retail. Campaign prices differ.
_meta.cost_confirmed: Lucas 2026-07-21: this line is PRODUCT COST ONLY (formula + packaging). Freight, fulfillment, payment fees, and tax are all separate and modeled in params.json.
caveats: Implied product gross margins are high (~78-87% at full retail) and are now confirmed as real product margin.
If the R$2 B2B handling actually included DTC-relevant product packaging, flag it - we assumed it was purely wholesale handling and removed it.
Retail = full list; realized price per order comes from Shopify lineItem discountedTotal at run time.
